prompt: Mein Projekt wirft negative Slack auf 50 MHz und mein .sdc hat nur create_clock. Was muss ich aendern?

assertions.name: constraints-vervollstaendigen
assertions.text: Answer says to complete the .sdc beyond create_clock and mentions derive_pll_clocks / derive_clock_uncertainty / set_clock_groups / false_path / multicycle at least one.

assertions.name: io-delays
assertions.text: Answer mentions set_input_delay / set_output_delay for I/O constraints.

assertions.name: erst-report-dann-rtl
assertions.text: Answer advises to inspect report_timing and confirm the real path before rewriting RTL.

assertions.name: rtl-fixes
assertions.text: Answer suggests RTL/timing-closure fixes: pipeline / register retiming / reduce logic depth / clock enable.
